sealed.statement: The immutable landing review envelope binds exact candidate-local generated manifests, source epoch, sealed evidence, additive verification templates, deterministic proof receipts, and a strict structured verifier verdict, while preserving the three-verb lifecycle and concise default output.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The implementation preserves start, continue, and land as the only primary operator verbs and places review-envelope preparation and verdict ingestion inside land.
doneWhen remains the sealed product success predicate; reviewReady and landReady requirements may gate review or commit but never redefine SOLVED.
Repository-global generated outputs are proven in an isolated HEAD plus exact-candidate snapshot and never accepted from a contaminated dirty worktree.
Verifier verdict files are bounded regular workspace files containing canonical plain JSON data; the immutable review owns fingerprint, scope, and paths.

findings.summary: Immutable review construction uses live Map, array, string, and regex intrinsics; post-import Map.prototype.values mutation suppresses the complete required-template bar.
Because the required-template bar can be minted empty, legacy direct verdict flags can again bypass structured category-complete review under a polluted runtime.
Generated-dependency accumulation and traversal still use live Array.prototype.push and iterator protocol, allowing all required generated-manifest receipts to be suppressed.
Landing-requirement lint traverses reviewReady through the live array iterator, so hostile replacement hides invalid declarations and diverges from enforcement.
